O2-repair-vs-resample: Opus 5.5: arm B = one attempt plus up to 3 repair rounds with Lean error messages; arm A = 4 independent attempts (attempt k)
O3-lemma-layer: Opus 5.5 with repair loop: arm R = repair only; arm RS = repair plus the Lean-checked lemma layer
O4-layer-with-search: Opus 5.5 with repair loop, lemma layer and name search (arm RT)
O5-repair-haiku: Haiku 4.5: arm B = repair loop; arm A = independent attempts
O5-repair-sonnet: Sonnet 5.5: arm B = repair loop; arm A = independent attempts
A1-astra: GPT-6 Astra (Codex, effort medium): R = proof plus up to 3 repair rounds with Lean errors; RS = R plus lemma layer; RT = R with read-only Mathlib sources to search; N0-N3 = independent attempts
A2-astra-effort-low: GPT-6 Astra, reasoning effort low (arms R, N0)
A2-astra-effort-high: GPT-6 Astra, reasoning effort high (arms R, N0)
E1-repair-decomposition: GPT-6 Astra, which part of Lean feedback makes repair work: after a shared first attempt (E0), V = full error messages, Z = line numbers only, B = only "Lean rejected this proof"
LS1-leanstral-loop: Leanstral 1.5 in a fixed check-and-repair loop: L1 = 1 candidate per round, L3 = up to 3
O3LA-leanstral-agent: Leanstral 1.5 as a tool-using agent (Mistral Vibe)
O3LA2-leanstral-agent-variants: Leanstral 1.5 agent on the 29 theorems O3LA left open: neu = fresh restart, fest = fixed instruction, staffel = staged budget
O3LA3-leanstral-agent-feedback: Leanstral 1.5 agent with goal-state feedback (arm rueck)
P1-astra-long-proofs: GPT-6 Astra (Codex, effort medium), at most 10 calls per theorem: W = whole proof plus repair rounds; WT = W with read-only Mathlib sources to search; P = Lean-checked skeleton of have-steps, then one step per call
D1-deepseek-16-samples: DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B (4-bit, local), 16 independent samples per theorem, no Lean feedback; 160 theorems: 80 DRIFT (human proof cites a lemma added after the 2025-05 snapshot) and 80 STABLE
UE1-deepseek-8-samples: DeepSeek-Prover-V2-7B (4-bit, local), 8 independent samples per theorem, no Lean feedback; 160 theorems: 80 DRIFT (human proof cites a lemma added after the 2025-05 snapshot) and 80 STABLE
